news_analysis.headline_hook: Fake challan link click panna 5 mins-la ungala bank account empty aagum!
news_analysis.breaking_event_summary: Cyber fraudsters in India have launched a new scam utilizing malicious Android Package Kit (APK) files disguised as traffic challan notices to compromise mobile devices, following a similar green gas scam.
news_analysis.retail_illusion: Retail investors assume this is a simple SMS annoyance or a legitimate ₹500 traffic fine that can be paid or inspected by tapping the link.
news_analysis.institutional_reality: Installing unauthorized APK files grants background accessibility permissions and SMS reading capabilities, allowing bad actors to silently intercept 2FA OTPs and drain Demat/banking accounts in minutes.
news_analysis.actionable_retail_rule: Never tap SMS links ending in .apk; strictly disable 'Install from Unknown Sources' in your phone settings and isolate your primary trading device.

slides.title: Fake challan link click panna account empty!

comparison_data.myth: Retail investors: '₹500 challan dhane, link-a click panni pay panniduvom' nu nambuvanga.
comparison_data.reality: Institutional reality: Adhu oru malicious APK file. Click panna, ungala phone-oda accessibility hackers-kitta poirum.

stat_data.label: Total Portfolio Liquidation Risk
stat_data.context: Once you install the APK, hackers gain SMS reading permissions. They intercept your bank OTPs and drain your Demat/Banking accounts in under 5 minutes. It's a total capital wipeout.

slides.title: Fraud epdi nadakkudhu? Step-by-step!
slides.card_text: 1. Fake SMS link-a click panna, oru .apk file download aagum. 2. 'Install from unknown sources' enable panna, app permission kuduthuduvenga. 3. Hackers background-la irundhu unga 2FA OTP-a steal panni, unga portfolio-va liquidating pannuvanga.

slides.title: Capital epdi drain aagudhu?
slides.card_text: Ungala phone-la irukkura banking apps-oda access avangalukku kedaichudum. Neenga trade pannum podhu, avanga real-time-la unga OTP-a intercept panni, unga Demat account-la irukkura stocks-a sell panni, funds-a transfer panniduvanga. It's a silent, invisible theft.

slides.title: Golden rule to protect capital!
slides.card_text: Never tap SMS links ending in .apk. Strictly disable 'Install from Unknown Sources' in your phone settings. Best practice: Isolate your primary trading device—don't use it for random browsing or clicking unverified links.
